description: This PHP class defines the entity 'PayGradeCurrency' for a Human Resource Management system, including its properties, ORM mappings, and getter/setter methods.

classes.name: PayGradeCurrency
classes.description: Entity representing the relationship between PayGrade and CurrencyType, including salary range properties.

methods.name: getCurrencyId
methods.description: Returns the currency ID associated with this pay grade currency.

methods.name: setCurrencyId
methods.description: Sets the currency ID for this pay grade currency.

methods.name: getPayGradeId
methods.description: Returns the pay grade ID associated with this entity.

methods.name: setPayGradeId
methods.description: Sets the pay grade ID for this entity.

methods.name: getPayGrade
methods.description: Returns the PayGrade entity linked to this record.

methods.name: setPayGrade
methods.description: Associates a PayGrade entity with this record.

methods.name: getCurrencyType
methods.description: Returns the CurrencyType entity linked to this record.

methods.name: setCurrencyType
methods.description: Associates a CurrencyType entity with this record.

methods.name: getMinSalary
methods.description: Retrieves the minimum salary bound for this currency and pay grade.

methods.name: getMaxSalary
methods.description: Retrieves the maximum salary bound for this currency and pay grade.
